create.name: Maison de l'Inspir
create.bio:
Maison de l'Inspir is a small house of Buddhist nuns in the Plum Village tradition of the Vietnamese Zen teacher Thich Nhat Hanh, set in the village of Villeneuve-sur-Bellot in Seine-et-Marne, east of Paris. The sisters who live there are his monastic disciples, and the community works closely with the brothers of the nearby Healing Spring Monastery at Verdelot. In October 2026 the house reopened with a new group of sisters after a quieter period.

The heart of its offering is the practice weekend: guests arrive on Friday and share the daily rhythm of sitting and walking meditation, a Dharma teaching, working meditation, silent meals and a Sunday sharing circle. Twice a month the two communities hold a Sunday Day of Mindfulness, one in French and one in Vietnamese, and there are longer retreats over Christmas and New Year. Everything runs on a donation basis, with lodging mostly in nearby guest houses, and people of any faith or none are welcome. Teaching is in French; the sisters point English speakers to other Plum Village centres.

courses.title: Week-ends de retraite (practice weekends)
courses.description: Friday-to-Sunday stays in which guests follow the sisters' monastic timetable: early sitting, walking meditation, a Dharma talk, mindful work and silent meals, ending with a sharing circle. No experience of meditation is needed. Taught in French.
courses.price: Donation-based; suggested 170 euros per weekend, including 40 euros for lodging

courses.title: Retraite de Noël (Christmas retreat)
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat over Christmas with the sisters, following the same rhythm of meditation, teaching and community life as the weekends. Registration is through the house's online form.

courses.title: Journées de Pleine Conscience (Days of Mindfulness)
courses.description: A non-residential Sunday of practice held with the monastic brothers and sisters at the Healing Spring Monastery in Verdelot: a morning teaching, walking meditation, a mindful vegan lunch and afternoon activities. Held twice a month, one day in French and one in Vietnamese, with a break over the summer.

free_resources.title: 4.1 Pratiques de bases
free_resources.description: The house's own French guide to the everyday practices used on retreat: conscious breathing, walking meditation, short verses to recite, listening to the bell, mindful eating and sitting meditation.
